title: Microsoft Purview: reasoning trace and confidence score for DLP triage agent alerts
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned trace and confidence score from the documented controls for the existing agent. The licensing statement follows its cited agent documentation, but should also acknowledge Microsoft's separate documentation of included Security Copilot capacity for eligible Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 customers.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a reasoning trace for alerts triaged by the Data Security Triage Agent in DLP, alongside each agent decision.
claims.quote: The feature will surface a reasoning trace alongside each agent decision and a confidence score

claims.fix: Keep the attribution to the DLP agent page and the mixed model, but add to the licensing notes and Cost and licensing: 'Microsoft's Security Copilot inclusion page separately states that eligible Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 customers receive included SCU capacity covering core agentic scenarios in Microsoft Purview; usage of that included capacity is not an hourly charge.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/security/security-copilot-inclusion. Qualify the cost rationale's 'under pay-as-you-go billing' as 'with pay-as-you-go billing documented on the agent page and included capacity separately documented for eligible Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 customers'.
